Shades & Tints Generator

Full tint and shade scale from one base color.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a base color.
  2. 19 swatches render: 9 tints, the base, 9 shades.
  3. Click any swatch to copy its HEX value.
  4. Use the scale for buttons, backgrounds and hover states.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the tints and shades computed?

Each of the 9 tints mixes the base color toward white in 10% steps (10%–90%); each of the 9 shades mixes toward black in the same steps. The base color sits in the middle.

Can I copy the colors?

Yes — click any swatch to copy its HEX value to the clipboard.

Is the scale perceptually uniform?

No — the mix is linear in sRGB space, which is simple and predictable but not perceptually uniform.
